spec.assertion: Structural trigger.kind === 'fullBurstEnter' plus behavioural: buffApply(atkPct 43.1) count === 2 x fullBurstStart count. Fails under the nearest-wrong burstCast keying (fires only on rotations maxwell herself casts, so the count drops below 2 x FB); the S1_ONCAST counterfactual proves the two are not interchangeable (team total differs).

spec.kitLine: Affects 2 allies w/ highest final ATK
spec.assertion: target.kind === 'alliesTopAtk', count 2, byFinalAtk true (kit says FINAL ATK literally), excludeSelf falsy (no except-the-skill-user clause). Behavioural: distinct recipient slugs < 4 and maxwell is among them; the S1_ALL counterfactual (target 'allies') yields > 2 x FB applications and higher team damage, so the top-2 slice is load-bearing rather than cosmetic.

Effect is buff/atkPct value 43.1 durationSec 10, durationShots undefined, and no casterAtkPct/highestAllyAtkPct sibling. Fails under a caster-scaled encoding (buffApply would emit a flat ATK number, not 43.1) and under a round-count reading. S1_LONG (durationSec 30) raises team damage, proving the 10s bound is real and not permanent; S1_OFF lowers it, proving non-vacuity.

Effect is buff/chargeSpeedPct 4.48 durationSec 10, and its buffApply count matches the ATK grant's (2 x FB) — same trigger, same target set. Fails if the charge-speed line were dropped as 'defensive/no damage' (it is a weapon-state modifier: both Burst III slots here wield charge weapons, so it gates shots fired).

Zero buffApply events for critRatePct 4.83 or critDamagePct 13.91 across the whole 180s fight — the v1 solo-raid scope has one boss, so the activation clause can never be satisfied. Fails under the nearest-wrong always-on-passive encoding. Non-vacuity proven by S2_PASSIVE: injecting exactly those two buffs as a passive raises maxwell's total, so their absence in BASE is a real signal, not a dead filter.

Exactly one weaponSwap effect, on a block with trigger.kind 'burstCast' and target.kind 'self'. Fails under a fullBurstEnter keying (would swap on any team FB, including rotations maxwell does not cast) and under a flatDamage encoding of the burst (which would ignore the shot economy entirely). B_OFF shows the swap carries > 10% of her total damage.

weaponSwap.damagePct === 813.42 exactly, read off the override. Combined with B_NOFC / B_AMMO6 / B_FASTCHG showing the swap responds to every parameter, this pins the per-shot multiplier rather than a fitted stand-in.
weaponSwap.chargeMultPct === 300; B_NOFC (chargeMultPct 100) strictly lowers maxwell's total, proving the x3 full-charge multiplier is applied and not folded into damagePct.

weaponSwap.chargeTimeSec === 2; B_FASTCHG (0.5s) strictly raises maxwell's total, proving the swap charge time gates shots fired inside the window rather than being decorative (base SR charge is 60f = 1s, so an unset chargeTimeSec would silently double her swap shot count).

weaponSwap.maxAmmo === 1; B_AMMO6 strictly raises maxwell's total, proving the 1-round magazine forces a 141-frame reload between every swapped shot. This is the weapon-state-is-damage line most often dropped as 'defensive'.

weaponSwap.hasPierce === true AND the file-level hasPierce flag is falsy. Fails under the nearest-wrong whole-fight encoding, which would Pierce-tag her base SR normals for all 180s and over-credit any teammate's Pierce Damage ▲. Structural only — the damage payload is unobservable in this fixture (see gaps).

weaponSwap.durationSec asserted only as a 5–15s sanity band, since the kit text states no duration; the ~10s Full-Burst window is the convention. Deliberately NOT pinned to an exact value — a precise assertion here would be a guessed ⚑, which is the failure mode, not the fix. Pin from footage (count swapped shots per burst window) to close it.

fixtures: controlComp('maxwell', true) for all 10 hoisted runs — liter B1 / crown B2 / maxwell B3 / helm B3, boss Fire, focus maxwell, deterministic (no seed). B1+B2 are mandatory: maxwell is a lone Burst III otherwise and would cast zero bursts, making every burst assertion vacuous. helm=true (the co-Burst-III) is deliberate and load-bearing: it is what makes fullBurstEnter and burstCast diverge in count, so the skill1 trigger-identity assertion actually discriminates. Runs: BASE, S1_OFF (skill1 emptied), S1_LONG (durationSec 30), S1_ALL (target -> allies), S1_ONCAST (trigger -> burstCast), S2_PASSIVE (skill2 injected as an always-on self buff), B_OFF (burst emptied), B_AMMO6, B_FASTCHG, B_NOFC. All counterfactuals go through withPatchedOverride, so the committed JSON is untouched. The file uses shape-tolerant slot accessors (slotBlocks/setSlotBlocks) because the packet describes the override slot as both a bare Block[] and a CharacterSkills-with-blocks[]; a patch that silently no-opped would turn every counterfactual green for the wrong reason.
gaps: burst 'Additional Effect: Pierce' — payload it.skip'd: the control comp contains no pierceDamagePct source, so Pierce tagging moves zero damage here and only the structural scoping (swap-level vs file-level flag) is testable. Closing it needs a fixture with a Pierce Damage ▲ carrier.

skill2 ACTIVE branch ('above 5 enemy unit(s)') — it.skip'd: v1 models a single solo-raid boss and the harness has no multi-enemy fixture, so only the inactive case is exercisable. The inactive assertion is kept honest by the S2_PASSIVE non-vacuity run.
burst weaponSwap durationSec — ⚑ kit-silent; asserted as a 5–15s band only. Exact value is measurement-gated (count swapped shots per burst window in footage).
